policy: Registry only. No benchmark data, source repositories, or patches are downloaded or redistributed by this project. Recheck current dataset, repository, and benchmark terms before each use.

swe-bench.task: Issue-driven repository-level bug fixing; evaluate resolved instances with the upstream harness.
swe-bench.notes: Dataset terms and each referenced repository's source license are separate. Use the official harness and permitted split; do not train on evaluation instances.

swe-bench-lite.task: Smaller SWE-bench issue-resolution subset; use the official subset definition and harness.
swe-bench-lite.notes: Confirm the subset's current distribution terms and each referenced repository license. Prevent overlap with training repositories and instances.

codesearchnet.notes: Review dataset terms and licenses of underlying repositories; use official splits and do not redistribute source snapshots by default.

codexglue.task: Software engineering tasks including code search, completion, translation, and defect detection.
codexglue.notes: The benchmark aggregates tasks and source corpora; verify terms for the selected task and all underlying data separately.

defects4j.task: Java real-world bugs with reproducible buggy/fixed versions and tests.
defects4j.notes: Install/use the official project tooling; inspect licenses of Defects4J and every project under test. Do not bundle checked-out projects.

bugsinpy.task: Python real-world bug benchmark with project-specific setup and test commands.
bugsinpy.notes: Inspect benchmark and per-project licenses and setup instructions before checkout or execution.

quixbugs.task: Small algorithmic bug-fixing benchmark with Java and Python implementations.
quixbugs.notes: Verify the upstream license and terms for the exact distribution/version used.
